guide: Open Start and type your shop name and your own limits in the yellow cells: margin before ads, target return, discount cap, open rate target and the days before a customer is lapsed.
Check Channels, Team, Products and Discount Codes: the other pages pick channels, people, SKUs and codes from them.
List your ad campaigns on Ad Campaigns with a daily budget and a target return, then type one row for each campaign and week on Ad Lines.
Plan the spend for each month and channel on Ad Budget Plan and read the variance and the check next to it.
Put every promotion on Marketing Calendar with dates, code, budget and goal, and read the margin check before you launch.
After a promotion ends, enter its orders, revenue, discount and cost of goods on Promotion Results and read the margin after ads and the uplift.
Enter your e-mail sends on E-mail Sends and the month figures on E-mail List; Segments holds the rules of your groups.
Plan content on Content Calendar, creator posts on Creator Posts, and sponsored listings on Sponsored Listings.
Fix listing problems on Product Feed Quality and keep the peaks on Seasonal Plan.
Read Monthly Marketing for cost per new customer and repeat rate, and Win-back List for customers who stopped ordering.

Use the 14 calculators for return, cost per order, budget split, discount cost, uplift, code check, campaign result, e-mail value, list growth, customer value, creator value, shipping offers, peak budget and what-if.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send 28 ready texts.
Read Marketing Dashboard and Charts every week.

listing.title: Online Seller Marketing Excel Template: Ad Return, Promotions, Discount Codes, E-mail List, Creator Posts, Peak Season Plan
listing.headline: Know what every ad, discount and e-mail really earns
listing.description:
Run the marketing of your online shop from one Excel workbook. Ad Campaigns and Ad Lines show spend, revenue, return and cost per order for every campaign and week, with the break-even return from your own margin and a verdict to scale, fix or pause. Ad Budget Plan sets planned spend against actual spend for each month and channel.

Marketing Calendar holds every promotion with its dates, code, budget and goal, and checks the margin left after the discount. Promotion Results shows revenue, discount, cost of goods, ad spend, margin after ads and the uplift on your usual orders. Discount Codes and Discount Cost show what each code and each month gives away against a cap you set.

E-mail Sends, E-mail List and E-mail Segments track open rate, click rate, revenue per e-mail, growth and churn. Creator Posts, Sponsored Listings, Content Calendar, Product Feed Quality, Seasonal Plan, Monthly Marketing and Win-back List cover the rest of the work.

14 calculators cover return, cost per order, budget split, discount cost, uplift, code check, campaign result, e-mail value, list growth, customer value, creator value, free shipping or percent off, peak budget and what-if. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details written in.

This is part six of the Online Seller suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small online shop to explore first. It helps you plan your work and does not promise results.

Hello, {name} spent {spend_4w} in four weeks against a budget of {budget_4w}. Please check the bids and tell me what you change today.
Hello, the return of {name} is {roas}, below the break-even return of {be_roas}. Please pause it or cut the budget and tell me what you found.
Hello, code {code} ends on {end}. Please remove it from the pages, e-mails and ads on that day.

messages.moment: Marketing: e-mail brief for a segment

Hello, the listing {sku} {product} on {channel} has {images} images and a score of {score}. Please add better images this week.
Hello, the result of {promo} is ready: revenue {revenue}, goal reached {goal_pct}, margin after ads {margin_ads}. Please read it before we plan the next one.
Hello, {name}: spend {spend}, revenue {revenue}, return {roas}, profit after ads {profit}. Verdict: {state}.
Hello, the budget for {name} is {budget} for a goal of {goal_revenue}. At the goal the margin after the budget is {margin_goal}. Please approve it.
Hello, {promo} gave away {discount} of discount and left {margin_ads} after ads. The goal reached was {goal_pct}. Please read the result sheet.

messages.moment: Owner: approve the ad budget for a month
messages.text: Hello, please approve the ad budget of {planned} for {channel} for the month starting {month}. Actual spend so far: {actual}.
Hello, {name} runs from {start} to {end} with a goal of {goal_revenue}. Please check stock and supplier orders for the products on offer.
Hello, expect more orders from {start} because of {name}. The code is {code}. Please plan packing and carrier pickups.
Hello, {name} ends on {end}. Please make sure that code {code} is switched off in every shop that day.
Hello, {theme} runs from {start} to {end}. We plan {stock_units} units, about {units_day} a day. Please plan extra packers and packaging.

Hello {creator}, your {platform} for {campaign} is due on {due_date}. Please send the draft two days before so that we can check it.
Hello {creator}, we sent your fee of {fee} for {campaign}. Thank you for the posts. Please confirm that it arrived.
Hello {creator}, your followers can use the code {code}. Please add it to your post, the link and the description.
Hello {name}, our new catalogue is ready. {offer}. May I send it to you? We would like to help with your next order.
Hello {name}, orders placed before the end of next week get these terms: {offer}. Your last order was on {last_order}.
Hello {name}, your offer is waiting: {offer}. It is valid for a short time. We hope to see you soon.

paragraphs: Campaign brief of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Promotion: {col:calendar.name} ({col:calendar.kind}) on {col:calendar.channel}, owner {col:calendar.owner}.
It runs from {col:calendar.start} to {col:calendar.end}, {col:calendar.days} days. The code is {col:calendar.code} with a discount of {col:calendar.disc_pct}.
The budget is {col:calendar.budget} ({col:calendar.budget_day} per day) for a goal of {col:calendar.goal_revenue} of revenue. At the goal the margin after the budget is {col:calendar.margin_goal}.
The owner of the campaign checks the pages, the ads, the code and the stock before the start and reports the result within a week of the end.

Month starting {col:budget.month}, channel {col:budget.channel}.
We ask to approve {col:budget.planned} of ad spend. Actual spend so far: {col:budget.actual}. Planned so far: {col:budget.expected}. Variance: {col:budget.variance}. Check: {col:budget.state}.
Spend above plan by more than {set:budget_tol} needs a reason before more money is added.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Peak season marketing plan
paragraphs: Peak season plan of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Peak: {col:seasonal.theme}, {col:seasonal.start} to {col:seasonal.end} ({col:seasonal.weeks} weeks). Focus: {col:seasonal.focus}.

We plan {col:seasonal.stock_units} units of stock, about {col:seasonal.units_day} a day, an ad budget of {col:seasonal.ad_budget} ({col:seasonal.ad_day} a day) and a discount of {col:seasonal.discount_pct}.
The goal is {col:seasonal.goal_revenue} of revenue. The ad budget is {col:seasonal.ad_share} of the goal. Timing: {col:seasonal.state}.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Promotion result review
paragraphs: Promotion result review of {set:shop}, dated {today}.
Promotion: {col:promores.promo}, {col:promores.start} to {col:promores.end}.
{col:promores.orders} orders gave {col:promores.revenue} of revenue against a goal of {col:promores.goal} ({col:promores.goal_pct}). The result shows: {col:promores.state}.

We gave {col:promores.discount} of discount ({col:promores.disc_share} of sales). The margin after discount was {col:promores.margin}, and after {col:promores.spend} of ads it was {col:promores.margin_ads}.
Orders per day were {col:promores.orders_day} against {col:promores.base_orders_day} usually, an uplift of {col:promores.uplift}.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Content calendar for the month
paragraphs: Content calendar summary of {set:shop}, for the month starting {col:acq.month}.
We planned {col:acq.content_n} pieces of content (e-mails, posts, pages) and published {col:acq.content_done}.
We sent {col:acq.email_rev} of e-mail revenue and spent {col:acq.spend} on ads in the same month.
Items not published are moved to the next month or dropped, and the reason is written in the content calendar.

ar.Still advertised, no stock: ما زال معلنًا عنه، لا مخزون
ar.The channels you sell through; the ad, b: القنوات التي تبيع من خلالها؛ تختار صفحات الإعلان والميزانية والترويج قناة من هذه القائمة.

ar.The products you advertise and put on sa: المنتجات التي تعلن عنها وتعرضها للبيع بالتكلفة والأسعار؛ يملأ هامش الويب من تلقاء نفسه.
ar.One row for each code with its value, mi: صف واحد لكل رمز بقيمته والحد الأدنى للطلب والتواريخ وحد الاستخدام؛ الطلبات والخصم المعطى وحصة الخصم وملء الحالة من الاستخدام الذي تدخله.
ar.One row for each ad campaign with its da: صف واحد لكل حملة إعلانية بميزانيتها اليومية والعائد المستهدف؛ الإنفاق، وإيرادات الإعلانات، والعائد، وتكلفة الطلب، والميزانية المستخدمة، وملء الحكم من الأسطر الإعلانية.

ar.One row for each campaign and week with: صف واحد لكل حملة وأسبوع يتضمن الإنفاق ومرات الظهور والنقرات والأوامر والإيرادات؛ معدل النقر، وتكلفة النقرة، وتكلفة الطلب، والعائد، وملء الحكم.

ar.One row for each month with the discount: صف واحد لكل شهر مع الخصم المقدم والمبيعات بعد الخصم؛ حصة المبيعات المقدمة، والخصم لكل طلب، وشيك مقابل الحد الأقصى الخاص بك.
ar.E-mail sends: opens, clicks and orders: يرسل البريد الإلكتروني: الفتح والنقرات والأوامر
ar.One row for each e-mail you send with th: صف واحد لكل بريد إلكتروني ترسله يتضمن عدد المرسل وعدد مرات الفتح والنقرات والأوامر والإيرادات؛ معدل الفتح، ومعدل النقر، والعائد لكل بريد إلكتروني، وملء الشيك.
ar.One row for each month with new subscrib: صف واحد لكل شهر مع المشتركين الجدد، وإلغاء الاشتراك، وحجم القائمة والإرسالات؛ صافي التغيير، والحصة غير المكتتب بها، والنمو، ومعدل الفتح، والإيرادات لكل تعبئة بريد إلكتروني.

ar.One row for each piece of content with t: صف واحد لكل جزء من المحتوى مع المالك والقناة وتاريخ الاستحقاق والحالة؛ أيام متبقية، وشيك متأخر أو مستحق قريبًا وسيقوم هاتف المالك بملء البيانات.

ar.Creator: صانع المحتوى
ar.One row for each product listing with ti: صف واحد لكل قائمة منتجات مع طول العنوان والصور والوصف؛ نقاط الجودة، والمشكلة التي تم العثور عليها، والتواريخ الثابتة، وأيام العمل، وملء الشيك.
ar.One row for each sponsored listing with: صف واحد لكل قائمة مدعومة تتضمن عروض الأسعار والنقرات والإنفاق والطلبات والإيرادات؛ العائد على الإنفاق، والتكلفة لكل طلب، وحصة الإنفاق من الإيرادات، وملء القرار.
ar.One row for each month with new and retu: صف واحد لكل شهر مع العملاء الجدد والعائدين والطلبات وإيرادات البيع بالتجزئة؛ يتم ملء الإنفاق الإعلاني والعائد والتكلفة لكل عميل جديد والخصم وإيرادات البريد الإلكتروني وأعداد المحتوى.
ar.One row for each customer with orders, r: صف واحد لكل عميل مع الطلبات والإيرادات وآخر طلب؛ منذ أيام، يتم ملء العلامة المتكررة وحالة العميل ونتيجة استرداد الأموال.

ar.Return on ad spend and break-even return: العائد على الإنفاق الإعلاني وعائد التعادل من الهامش

ar.Return you want, from your settings: العودة التي تريدها، من الإعدادات الخاصة بك
ar.Profit for each unit of ad spend: الربح لكل وحدة من الإنفاق الإعلاني

ar.Most a new customer may cost over a year: قد يكلف معظم العملاء الجدد أكثر من عام

ar.Cost per new customer this year: التكلفة لكل عميل جديد هذا العام

ar.Check against your margin floor: تحقق من أرضية الهامش الخاص بك

ar.Discount if the second code is added too: خصم إذا تم إضافة الكود الثاني أيضا
ar.Stacking check against your margin floor: فحص التراص مقابل أرضية الهامش الخاص بك
ar.Uses left, 0 when there is no limit: يستخدم اليسار، 0 عندما لا يكون هناك حد
ar.Type the goal, the revenue, the discount: اكتب الهدف والإيرادات والخصم والإنفاق الإعلاني للحملة؛ انظر إلى أي مدى وصلت إلى هدفها، والهامش بعد السلع والإعلانات، وتكلفة كل طلب.
ar.E-mail revenue per send from list and ra: إيرادات البريد الإلكتروني لكل إرسال من القائمة والأسعار
ar.Type the list size, open rate, click rat: اكتب حجم القائمة ومعدل الفتح ومعدل النقرات ونسبة النقرات بهذا الترتيب؛ شاهد عمليات الفتح والنقرات والأوامر والإيرادات لإرسال واحد وشهر، وقارنها مع عمليات الإرسال الحقيقية.
ar.Share of the list lost in a year: حصة من القائمة المفقودة في السنة
ar.Revenue per e-mail in your real sends: الإيرادات لكل بريد إلكتروني في عمليات الإرسال الحقيقية

it.Enter your e-mail sends on E-mail Sends: Inserisci le tue email inviate su Invio di posta elettronica e le cifre del mese su Elenco di posta elettronica; I segmenti contengono le regole dei tuoi gruppi.

it.Read Monthly Marketing for cost per new: Leggi Marketing mensile per il costo per nuovo cliente e il tasso di ripetizione e Elenco di riconquista per i clienti che hanno smesso di ordinare.
it.Use the 14 calculators for return, cost: Utilizza i 14 calcolatori per reso, costo per ordine, suddivisione del budget, costo dello sconto, aumento, controllo del codice, risultato della campagna, valore dell'e-mail, crescita dell'elenco, valore del cliente, valore del creatore, offerte di spedizione, budget di punta e cosa succede se.
it.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Stampa 10 fogli e 10 documenti, segui 10 liste di controllo e tocca il collegamento di un messaggio per inviare 28 testi pronti.
it.Read Marketing Dashboard and Charts ever: Leggi Cruscotto di marketing e grafici ogni settimana.
it.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Tutti gli elenchi a discesa del file. Modifica qui una voce e si aggiornerà in tutti i fogli.
it.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Si aggiorna dai tuoi fogli. Cambia l’anno per consultare i dati passati.
it.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Scegli nella cella gialla; il resto si compila da sé. Il modulo è pronto da stampare.
it.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Modifica qui il testo; le parole tra {braces} vengono compilate usando i dati di ogni riga. I collegamenti si trovano nelle tabelle.
it.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Scegli una voce: ogni passaggio avrà la propria data di scadenza. Crea una copia di questo foglio per ogni voce.
